headline: PHI @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 2.74 at LAD 4.52, with a projected total of 7.26. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAD: PHI moved -0.52 runs while LAD moved +0.99, changing the projected margin by -1.50 runs. The projected total climbed +0.47, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Yoshinobu Yamamoto has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Freddie Freeman, Shohei Ohtani, Teoscar Hernández, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adolis García because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
